## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/verify-gha-runner.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Script runs gh auth status first; exits 1 immediately if auth fails (no further commands)
- [ ] Script runs gh run list --workflow=$WORKFLOW_NAME --limit 1; captures stdout+stderr
- [ ] On success: logs output as story comment via .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment $STORY_ID
- [ ] On gh run list non-zero exit: exits 1 (does not log partial output as success)
- [ ] Script reads STORY_ID from env (default: 7705-41e8-9f01-4ebb)
- [ ] Script reads WORKFLOW_NAME from env (default: reconcile-bridge.yml)
- [ ] All RED tests from b456-9a60-ce0c-4b8c now pass (GREEN)
